title: Jumanji: The Next Level
tagline: The game is back. So is lunch.
about: The friends return to Jumanji to rescue Spencer, but the game has changed and two grandpas got sucked in too.
cue: Serve the mains when the friends get sucked back into the game.
faces: Serve the mains when the friends get sucked back into the game.
“Spencer, I came in for a quiet life and now I'm an avatar again. At least feed me first.” Eddie

Jumanji Desert OutpostJumanji: The Next LevelThe game is back. So is lunch.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersRope bridge banana bitesFrozen banana slices dipped in dark chocolate and crushed peanutsHow to make it3 bananas150g dark chocolate100g peanuts, crushedSlice the bananas into thick rounds. Melt the chocolate.Dip each slice halfway in the chocolate and roll the chocolate side in crushed peanuts. Lay on a lined tray.Freeze for 30 minutes until set. Serve straight from the freezer.Jungle fruit cupsPineapple, mango, papaya and lychee with lime, mint and chilli saltHow to make it1/2 pineapple1 mango1/2 papaya400g lychees, drained2 limes, juiced1 tbsp torn mintchilli salt, to tasteCube the pineapple, mango and papaya and mix with the lychees.Spoon into cups, squeeze over the lime juice and scatter with mint.Finish each cup with a pinch of salt mixed with chilli for a little kick.MainsMountain fortress goulashBeef goulash with sweet paprika and red pepper, over buttered egg noodlesHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions, sliced3 tbsp sweet paprika400g crushed tomatoes1 red capsicum, sliced400g egg noodles30g butter2 tbsp oilBrown the beef in the oil in batches. Add the onions and paprika and stir for a minute.Add the tomatoes, capsicum and enough water to cover.Simmer for 3 hours until thick and tender.Cook the noodles, toss with butter and serve the goulash over the top.Grandpa's diner glazed meatloafEddie and Milo's old dinerHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef and pork meatloaf with onion and breadcrumbs, glazed with tomato and brown sugar and baked sticky, with creamy mash, green beans and gravy.Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, a grated onion, an egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt.Press into a loaf tin.Spread with 100ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180°C for 1 hour.Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk.Steam 300g green beans.Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and stock.SweetsFalcon jewel jellyLime jelly set with kiwi and green grapes, topped with whipped creamHow to make it2 packets of lime jelly crystals3 kiwifruits, diced300g green grapes, plus 4 extra whole300ml thickened cream, whippedMake up the jelly following the packet. Halve most of the grapes.Pour the jelly into clear glasses with the kiwifruit and halved grapes.Chill for 3 hours until set.Top with whipped cream and finish each glass with one perfect grape like a jewel.DrinksDesert oasis coolerBlended watermelon with lime and mint, chilled and poured over iceHow to make it1kg watermelon flesh2 limes, juiced1 handful mint, plus sprigs to serve1 bag iceBlend the watermelon, lime juice and mint until smooth.Strain into a jug and chill well.Pour over ice in tall glasses with a fresh mint sprig on top.
